description: Convert text between camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case and more.

faqs.a: Input is split on spaces, underscores, hyphens and case boundaries (so "myVarName", "my-var-name" and "my var name" all work), then reassembled in the style you pick.
faqs.q: How does it understand my input?

faqs.a: Each style shows its own copy button, so you can grab exactly the format you need without retyping.
faqs.q: How do I copy a specific style?

faqs.a: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser; nothing is sent anywhere.

howto: Type or paste your text (variable name, title, phrase).
All six case styles are generated instantly below.
Click the copy button next to the style you need.
Paste it into your code or document.
title: Case Style Converter
